seen_animation: A line-drawn butterfly (two lobed wings, segmented body line with tick marks, looped antenna and a leaf-tipped antenna) sits on top of a large grey outline that reads as a hand with fingers. In frame 1 the butterfly is near the upper center of the frame with its wings tilted about 45 degrees to the lower left. In frames 2-5 the butterfly and the grey hand outline drift to the left and slightly up together, the hand growing larger in frame. Frames 5-12 hold roughly the same position with small changes in wing outline and tilt. In frames 13-16 the butterfly turns more upright and its wings narrow, as if folding together, while it sits slightly further left; the hand outline stays under it.
seen_film: A monarch butterfly with wings closed and held upright perches on the fingertips of a hand against a black background. In frames 1-4 the hand and butterfly drift left and up in the frame and the wing rises taller above the fingertip. Frames 5-12 hold this position with small changes in the wing silhouette (a slight flutter/opening around 9-12). In frames 13-16 the lighting changes, the hand sits lower-left, and the butterfly stands tall and vertical with its folded wing showing orange, pointing straight up.
named_subject: a butterfly perched on a hand
evidence: Frames 1-4: animation butterfly and hand outline move from upper center toward the upper left, matching the film's leftward drift of hand and butterfly in frames 1-4. Frames 5-12: both hold position with small wing changes in both. Frames 13-16: animation butterfly becomes more vertical and narrower, matching the film's change to an upright folded wing at frame 13. Across all frames the butterfly stays drawn with the doodle's lobed wing outlines, tick-marked body line and two different antenna tips, with no doubling or sudden redraw between neighbours (judged from still frames only).
primary_gap: The film's butterfly holds its wings closed as one tall upright blade rising well above the fingertip (clearest in film frames 4, 10 and 13-16), while the animation keeps both wings spread as a rounded mass tilted about 45 degrees until frame 13 and only partly narrows afterwards.
closes_when: In frames 4-16 the two wing outlines overlap into a narrow shape pointing nearly straight up from the fingertip, standing taller above the hand outline, with frames 13-16 the most vertical.
protect: The doodle's construction (two-lobed wing outlines, straight body line with small tick marks, looped antenna and leaf-tipped antenna, plain uniform black stroke); the joint leftward drift of butterfly and hand in frames 1-5; the hold in frames 5-12; the move to a more upright pose at frame 13; consistent drawing from frame to frame without doubling.
identity_gap: The character keeps the doodle's lobed wings, tick-marked body and two distinct antenna tips, though the wings are compressed narrower than the wide-spread pose in c.png, which is consistent with folding wings.
